This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed
the following:
 Order

The applicant has filed this THIRD bail application u/S 439 Cr.P.C. for grant of bail in connection with Crime No. 526/2022 registered at Police Station: Bairasiya, ,District Bhopal for the offences punishable under Sections 170, 171, 419, 420/34 of the I.P.C.
His earlier applications were dismissed as withdrawn.

2. 1 evidence/ witnesses is remote.

sentences.text: It is further submitted that as per the allegations, the applicant misrepresented himself as police officer and tried to extract money, but now he has learnt the lesson hardways and would mend his ways by becoming a better citizen and not involving in criminal activities.
Confinement amounts to pre-trial detention.
He undertakes to cooperate in trial and will abide by all the terms and conditions as imposed by this court.
He further undertakes to perform community service to purge his misdeeds if any and to save National/Environmental/Social Cause.
Under these grounds, counsel prayed for bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate for the State opposed the prayer and prayed that the application be dismissed.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties at length and perused the case diary.
5.

Considering the above submissions advanced by the learned counsel for the parties, a chance be given to the applicant for course correction, therefore, without commenting on the merits of the case, and as per the spirit of community service echoed in the order of Sunita Gandharva Vs. State of M.P. reported in 2020(3) MPLJ (Cri.) 247, the application is allowed with certain conditions..
